content.comment_body: I'm definitely missing something in the [document]. Which [product_name] should I use to get an analog output? I currently have a [product_name] with 12/24 RC, but I'm willing to switch models or add a module if necessary. Any advice appreciated.

No [product_name] comes with analog output built-in, but you can add an expansion module for this purpose. Attach it to the right side of your [product_name]. The module you need is the AM2 AQ, which offers two analog outputs: 0-10V or 0(4)-20 mA.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is confused about which [product_name] supports analog outputs, noting the documentation does not provide enough guidance. Another user clarifies that analog outputs are only available via an expansion module, rather than being built into the base module. This highlights a gap in the documentation concerning analog output options in the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the documentation to clearly specify which [product_name] modules can provide analog outputs and to offer direct guidance about the necessary hardware for adding analog outputs to their setup.
